content.value: Many familiar creatures have custom RPG attributes and are substantially tougher than their vanilla versions. Do not judge an encounter from the vanilla heart count alone: enemies can carry Armor, Evasion, Energy Shield, elemental resistances, critical stats, damage conversion, penetration, leech, and ailment chances.

Undead: Zombie, Husk, Drowned, Zombie Villager, Skeleton, Stray, Bogged, and Wither Skeleton.
Arthropods: Spider, Cave Spider, Silverfish, and Endermite.
Raiders and casters: Pillager, Vindicator, Witch, Evoker, Vex, and Ravager.
Nether threats: Blaze, Magma Cube, Ghast, Zombified Piglin, Piglin, Piglin Brute, Hoglin, Zoglin, and Strider.
Other hostile threats: Creeper, Guardian, Phantom, Breeze, Enderman, Shulker, and Slime.
Defensive or neutral creatures: Iron Golem, Snow Golem, Polar Bear, Wolf, and Armadillo.

Use the overhead entity display to read current health and Energy Shield and to recognize ailments. Armor is strongest against small physical hits but less efficient against very large hits; high Evasion can avoid entity-sourced attacks; resistances specialize a creature against particular elements. Negative resistance is a vulnerability. Freeze and Electrocute prevent movement and pause supported mob attack cooldowns while active.

Zombie: 60 maximum health, 12 attack damage, 30 Armor, -25% fire resistance, and 15% Chance to Bleed.
Skeleton: 45 maximum health, 14 attack damage, 10 Armor, 40 Evasion, -25% fire resistance, faster projectiles, and enhanced critical stats.
Wolf: 60 maximum health, 16 attack damage, 20 Armor, 45 Evasion, Bleed chance, and enhanced critical stats before wolf armor is considered.
Armadillo: 30 maximum health, 150 Armor, full knockback resistance, and 50% reduced critical damage taken.
Equipment worn by an Act 1 zombie, skeleton, or piglin adds its own base stats and runes on top of the creature's built-in attributes. See Mob Equipment for generation and drop chances.
